validFrom.description: First day the plan is active, YYYY-MM-DD

notes.description: General notes shown on the Piano page

label.description: Short tag shown on the day tab, e.g. "dolce"

note.description: One-line note for the day, e.g. "pranzo in famiglia · cena libera"

expectedProtein.description: Expected protein for the day in grams

time.description: Local time of the meal, HH:MM (24-hour). Optional: without it Intake uses a default slot for the meal type

type.description: Meal type used when logging. Optional: inferred from the title (colazione, pranzo, cena, spuntino) when missing

description.description: Readable one-line summary of the meal

name.description: Food, e.g. "Yogurt greco" or a free-text line such as "1 frutto"

macros.description: Estimated nutrients for the whole meal. Needed for "Mangiato come previsto" to log complete values

sugar.description: Total sugar in grams. Must be given together with addedSugar.

addedSugar.description: Added sugar in grams, part of sugar (never more than sugar). Must be given together with sugar.

saturatedFat.description: Saturated fat in grams, part of fat (never more than fat)

sodiumMg.description: Sodium in milligrams (not salt: 1 g of salt is about 400 mg of sodium)

caffeineMg.description: Caffeine in milligrams, only for caffeine sources
